kinds.a: AAC device · speech-generating device · voice output communication aid
kinds.d: Device or board that speaks or shows messages for a person who cannot rely on their own speech.
Eye tracker fixed to a computer or tablet so a person with little movement can control it and communicate by gaze.

notes: Cut the Tobii Dynavox SKUs from 5 to 3 across the shelf. I kept TD I-13, a mainstream speech tablet, and TD Navio, a handheld communicator, under Communication aid. I moved TD Pilot to Eye-gaze device, since it is an eye-gaze iPad. I dropped TD I-110 and TD I-16 as size/SKU variants of the same I-series. I dropped 'Crescendo 60 Personal Communications System' because it had no maker and could not be placed without research. I added PRC-Saltillo (Accent) and Smartbox (Grid Pad) as ranges, as the brief asked, so the list is not Tobii-only. Device formats (dedicated device, app on tablet, low-tech board or book; add-on vs integrated eye tracker) are recorded as types in 't', not as separate kinds. Old sources are kept unchanged.
